verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's MCP docs list a Create-Dashboard tool that builds a dashboard from text cards and reports, which covers composing saved reports into a dashboard. The marketing site describes results 'delivered as a dashboard you and your team can keep working from' and an 'interactive view' for team alignment. The core is evidenced, but only through an MCP tool listing and marketing copy rather than dedicated dashboard documentation. Missing for 10: first-party dashboard docs for the in-UI workflow, documented sharing and permission controls for team members, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
